task.title: DialogClose aria-label collision: Cancel and X share one accessible name
task.description: Filed from P6-125 (2026-08-11). DialogClose sets aria-label="Close dialog" unconditionally regardless of children text, so a Cancel button and the X close button in one dialog share one accessible name — screen readers announce both as Close dialog and role/name queries cannot disambiguate (P6-125's tests had to fall back to structural selectors). Fix: only apply the fallback aria-label when the button has no text children. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.
